[PREFERENCE] User is interested in tips for pairing cocktails with spicy food.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for pairing cocktails with spicy food:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Contrast the heat with sweet, sour, or creamy elements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose spirits like tequila, mezcal, or whiskey to balance heat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use acidity (like lime or grapefruit) to cut through richness and heat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. A touch of sweetness can counterbalance heat.
